# point-index disk v1 golden fixtures

These immutable files were generated by the `point-index` disk-version 1
encoder from the one-point `clustered_ticks(1)` test Source:

- `one-point.pidx` is a 408-byte complete artifact (`BLAKE3
  d9e0769b00bfe5f35845f94fab5b67107b85d94feb54175e7b56ee3e6bf48954`,
  `SHA-256 346f568ccb4674c5d81213fa755bdc463497a2ec5b9105a8df8c6f22962c8d6c`).
- `one-point.pidx.work` is the resumable work file after its single durable
  Source block, 344 bytes (`BLAKE3
  e81496a3e1f42526599394d12fd9234a13d1da9c88233c0b7fee83536c010810`,
  `SHA-256 f35720941053a47b68ab48a3509bd34796756faf19da3d8c3ae9f2b18e7cb288`).

The persistence integration test opens and resumes these checked-in bytes. Do
not regenerate them unless disk version 1 is intentionally replaced or a new
reader migration is added; keep these v1 files when adding later versions.
